reasoning.step1:
Step 1 — reasoning to extract structured invoice data:

1) Document classification
- Invoice indicators present: Title "RECHNUNG", "Rechnungsdatum", "Nettobetrag", "USt.", "Rechnungsbetrag", line item table with Menge/Preis/Gesamt. No exclusion terms like "Mahnung" or "Zahlungserinnerung". Conclusion: treat as invoice.

2) Locate key fields
- Invoice date: found as "Rechnungsdatum: 27.11.2023".
- Sender VAT ID: found near footer "UST.ID-Nr.: ATU     53752103" → consolidated as "ATU53752103".
- Grand total: line "Rechnungsbetrag 36.118,5000 EUR" → grand total value "36.118,5000" (European formatting: dot thousands, comma decimals).
- Net amount: line "Nettobetrag 32.835,0000 EUR" → net "32.835,0000".
- VAT amount: line "3.283,5000 EUR" immediately after VAT line → VAT amount "3.283,5000".
- VAT rate: shown as "+   10,00% USt. von 32.835,00" → VAT rate "10,00" (strip percent sign per rules; keep formatting/decimals as in input).

3) Verify consistency and rules
- No exclusion dominance; headers align with invoice.
- No need to infer missing values.
- Preserve number decimal places exactly as in input (Net, Vat, GrandTotal each have four decimal places in input).
- VAT rate should be returned without "%" and with same decimal formatting ("10,00" appears in text).
- Sender VAT consolidated without spaces.
- Ensure these are the invoice-level VAT values (they apply to entire invoice) — valid to include as Vat.Item entries.

4) Potential ambiguities considered and resolved
- Number formatting: input uses European separators (period for thousands, comma for decimals). For extraction, preserve the numeric digits and decimal precision observed; conversion to JSON numeric format will require standard decimal point, but do not invent additional precision.
- Multiple occurrences: only one set of invoice-level net/vat/total values present; will return single entries.

Conclusion: ready to populate schema fields with:
- Invoice.Date = "27.11.2023"
- Sender.VatId = "ATU53752103"
- GrandTotal.Amount = 36.118,5000 (value from "Rechnungsbetrag 36.118,5000 EUR")
- Net.Amount = 32.835,0000
- Vat.Amount = 3.283,5000
- Vat.Rate = 10,00
